name: Create Piano Keyboard Diagram
description:
Create a labeled diagram of a one-octave piano keyboard in ActivInspire.

Your task:
1. Create a new flipchart.
2. Create a title text 'Piano Keys' at the top.
3. Draw 7 white rectangles side-by-side to represent the white keys.
4. Draw 5 black rectangles for the black keys. Place them in the correct pattern: a group of 2, a gap, then a group of 3. They should overlap the white keys.
5. Add text labels 'C', 'D', 'E', 'F', 'G', 'A', 'B' on the corresponding white keys (C is to the left of the 2-black-key group).
6. Save the flipchart to '/home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/piano_keyboard.flipchart'.

metadata.pattern_description: 7 white keys, 5 black keys in groups of 2 and 3
